snippet.title: Mystery of Unicorn Castle
snippet.description:
Mystery of Unicorn Castle for PC: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/3657/mystery-of-unicorn-castle/index.html

Mystery of Unicorn Castle for Mac: http://www.bigfishgames.com/download-games/7872/mac/mystery-of-unicorn-castle/index.html

Jane Morion always considered herself to be an ordinary girl. Then a letter arrived describing the inheritance of a family castle. Solve a mystery where dreams and magic intertwine. Explore rooms inside the castle while detecting hidden objects.
